name: Fruit Cut
summary:
This game is meant for young children, and is similar in nature to the simple fruit cutting toys common for toddlers.

Slow down and enjoy the simple sensory experience of cutting into fruit and other foods.

Fruit Cut is a cozy, hands-on food playground for Meta Quest. Pick up a toy knife, slice through colorful fruits and vegetables, and discover what’s inside - from an apple’s star-shaped center to the hidden chambers of a pepper.
